language.name: English
ui.keymap_warn: ⚠ There is no command to read the keymap from the device. The app keeps its state in keymap-state.json (initialised from the default keymap extracted from the capture). If you remap keys with the vendor app, what is shown here will DIFFER from the device — press "Reset to default" to resync.
ui.capture_key_tip: Click, then press a key or combo on your real keyboard (hold Ctrl and press C → Ctrl+C; tap Ctrl alone → LCtrl)
ui.capture_hint: Waiting for a key… press a key, or hold Ctrl / Shift / Alt and press a key (→ combo). Tap Ctrl / Shift / Alt alone → assign that modifier. For combos with Win use the Key combo tab.
ui.search_placeholder: 🔍 Filter keys: name or hex code (e.g. F5, Num, 0x2A)
ui.combo_tip: Tip: click ⌨ Capture key, then hold Ctrl and press C on your real keyboard. Only left-side modifiers are supported so far (captures 10, 11).
ui.effects_note: Blue outline = active on the device. Apply effect: read 0x84 → change 0x0A (+ that effect's brightness / speed 0–4 if you moved the slider) → write 0x04 — byte-for-byte like the vendor app (capture batch 6). Colors stay unchanged. Self-define (per-key colors) is not supported.
ui.rgb_order_note: R, G, B — same byte order as on the wire
ui.lighting_warn: Apply: read 0x84 → if not in static mode, write 0x04 (mode = 01, read-modify-write, only offset 0x0A changes) → write 0x0A. Other color slots stay as in the capture. There is no command to read the color table, so the color currently on the device cannot be shown.
ui.connection_note: Wired (258A:010C) is preferred, otherwise the 2.4G receiver (3554:FA09). After switching mode / waking the numpad: press Rescan. Over 2.4G you can write the base layer, static color and sleep; close the vendor app first.
ui.sleep_note: Unit 30 s, the vendor app's 10 steps (30 s … 20 Min). Both modes share the settings block: changing it over the cable also applies to 2.4G. The OFF switch has no capture yet, so it is not supported.
ui.app_data_note: Apply writes straight to the numpad and reports the result; the hex of every packet sent / received is in the log.
ui.updates_note: Only reads the public release feed on GitHub (tvPhi/K3Pro/releases.atom) — nothing about you or your device is sent.
